selected_evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
selected_evidence.summary: CA generated (ca.key/ca.crt) and used to sign node1/node2/node3 server certs and the replicator client cert; primary's postgresql.conf enables ssl with those certs; pg_basebackup succeeded using sslmode=verify-full with the CA-signed client cert; pg_stat_replication join to pg_stat_ssl shows ssl=t for both standby connections

selected_evidence.requirement: Replication connections accepted only from peers presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA
selected_evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full; a connection attempt with no client cert is rejected ('connection requires a valid client certificate'); a connection using a freshly generated self-signed (non-CA) certificate is rejected at the TLS layer ('unknown ca')
